name: extract_invoice
description: Record one financial document (invoice, receipt or credit note) as structured data. Call this tool exactly once per document. Fill every field from the document text only: use null for any field the document does not state, and never infer, estimate or invent a value. Normalise dates to YYYY-MM-DD and amounts to plain decimals with no symbols or thousands separators. Currency: 'S$', 'SGD' and 'GST' imply SGD; a named currency outside the enum (for example Thai baht) is 'other' with currency_detail set to its ISO code; no currency stated at all is 'unclear'. Set calculated_total to the arithmetic sum of line_items, set conflict_detected to true when that sum differs from stated_total by more than 0.01, and set missing_information when a required value lives somewhere the document only refers to (an attachment, a schedule, a link).

invoice_id.description: The document's own reference number (INV-, R-, CN- ...)

due_date.description: null when the document states no due date

currency_detail.description: ISO code when currency is 'other', otherwise null

category_detail.description: free text when category is 'other', otherwise null

stated_total.description: The total printed on the document; negative for a credit note

conflict_detected.description: true when calculated_total and stated_total differ by more than 0.01

missing_information.description: Name the information the document refers to but does not contain (for example 'line detail in attached schedule A'); null when nothing is missing
